findings.desc: quality-fail-closed: packages/main/src/handlers/certification-window.ts:87-102 collectAdmitFacts catch blocks set missingRequiredIntents=0 and openBlockingFindingIds=[] when coverage or finding/policy reads throw, so certification_window_begin can ADMIT. The same function fail-closes an unreadable dirty-tree classifier. PRE_CERT admit must refuse when required facts cannot be computed.

quality-fail-closed: packages/main/src/core/certification-window.ts:266 windowAuthorizesHeavyCertification(window, null) returns Boolean(window.receiptId). loadVerifiedCertificationWindow:653-654 only verifies a receipt when one is found, so deleting receipts[] from certification-window.json while leaving a signed ADMITTED window+receiptId still authorizes done_required_validate / validate --full. A missing PRE_CERT receipt must fail closed.
